purpose: Whole-process instruction comparisons on reduced ADR0104 inputs; no wall-clock or release-target claim.

method.counterbalancing: base then candidate in dive profile; candidate then base in TLC profile
method.acceptance: At least 5% fewer instructions geometrically across all eight complete cells, with identical observable counts/depth and no meaningful individual regression.

reductions.EWD998PCal: Copy EWD998PCal.cfg unchanged; in EWD998PCal.tla change StateConstraint counter[i]<3 to counter[i]<2.

boxed_value_errors.description: Box private cold ValueError details: ValueError32→8bytes and both Result<Value,ValueError>/Result<bool,ValueError>32→16bytes, preserving public behavior.

four_byte_fingerprint_extension.description: Four-byte GF(2) table extension preserving the fingerprint byte stream, plus skipping the initial traversal-stack allocation for scalars.
four_byte_fingerprint_extension.correctness_controls: Existing pinned TLC64-bit dumps, lazy/deep traversal tests, and independent GF(2) basis/zero/arbitrary controls for all131polynomials passed; these controls do not imply a performance win.

inline_settled_leaves.description: Inline settled literal values, assigned typed state values and direct local value/function reads before the large evaluator dispatch; fallback and errors unchanged.
inline_settled_leaves.result: Rejected; all eight cells increased instructions and no runtime change landed.

matched_causal_diagnostic.instrumentation: Valgrind3.22.0 Callgrind, default cache simulation disabled
matched_causal_diagnostic.assembly_observation: Expanded inline-marked wrapper remained out of line, with larger register-save prologue, fallback call and repeated IR-node fetch/discriminant check.
matched_causal_diagnostic.qualification: This diagnostic explains the observed failed pair. It does not establish that forced inlining, another dispatch layer or another cache would improve the full matrix. Inclusive recursive costs were not added.

profile_context.instrumentation: Callgrind3.22.0, separate from Cachegrind paired instruction experiments; never compare raw counts across tools.

dive.qualification: Inclusive direct means self plus recorded outgoing call costs; recursive cost overlaps and may exceed the total. Do not add inclusive rows.

tlc.qualification: Inclusive direct means self plus recorded outgoing call costs; recursive cost overlaps and may exceed the total. Do not add inclusive rows.

cross_matrix_constraints.qualification: Parentless empty-frame allocation is a subset; dominant GameOfLife Sum/score frames have arguments/captures. Function-domain comparison is material in MCbtree/default but absent or small elsewhere. These shares do not establish a five-percent geometric opportunity; recursive inclusive costs overlap.

foreign_thunk_cache_hypothesis.hypothesis: Box only the cold foreign-domain cache slot, preserving ordinary cached/store semantics.
foreign_thunk_cache_hypothesis.decision: Not implemented; retained costs provide no credible five-percent matrix case. No new profile or native workload executed.

visible_cost_elimination_scenario.qualification: Optimistically deletes all cached/store/callee_env/Thunk-drop exclusive instructions and direct Thunk mi_free call costs, including required ordinary-domain work. This is an intentionally overgenerous scenario for these named costs, not a rigorous global upper bound: constructors are inlined into multiple callers and source-line allocator costs can be conflated. It cannot justify a five-percent whole-matrix claim.

foreign_thunk_cache_hypothesis.constructor_attribution: No named Thunk::new symbol and no separately charged foreign-field constructor lines. Constructor code is inlined into multiple callers and generic allocator/source locations; source annotation cannot assign a rigorous total constructor saving. Absence of a named symbol does not mean zero cost.
foreign_thunk_cache_hypothesis.inclusive_qualification: Ordinary-domain cached/store work and captured-value destruction remain required. Inclusive destruction reaches over seven percent in GameOfLife but includes required recursive captured values; do not add overlapping inclusive rows or attribute INSTANCE forcing cost to cache construction.
